'''''Wanted Poster: Han Solo''''' was a poster produced by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a series of conflicts between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It depicted two photos&mdash;one from the front and another from the side&mdash;of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] that was instrumental in the events leading to the destruction of the Empire's first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] above the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text, the [[Writing/Legends|alphabet]] of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], along the top read "ALIAS: HAN SOLO" while the text at the bottom read "WANTED" with the Imperial emblem in the left-bottom corner. The poster was [[Color/Legends|colored]] in shades of blue and green. Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were known to carry copies of the poster on their person.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Wanted Poster: Han Solo'' was a poster that appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. It could be looted by the player from the corpses of fallen stormtroopers along with [[Wanted Poster: Luke Skywalker|wanted]] [[Wanted Poster: Princess Leia Organa|posters]] for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. The player could use the poster as decoration in one of their personal structures.
